name: The Last Demon
source:
After days of traveling, you stop by a village... and find a demon?

Join Delek as you travel with him back home and find love on the way! If you choose the right options, that is.

[Edited from [url=http://kan12.itch.io/the-last-demon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过几天的旅行，你停在一个村庄……并发现了一个恶魔？

与德勒克一起回家，并在途中找到爱情！如果你选择正确的选项，那就是。

[编辑自[url=http://kan12.itch.io/the-last-demon]Itch.io[/url]]
